visual_name: Day in the life, part forty five: the wheel (low-poly 3D)
code_name: three.js bike repair shop (cut away at the front: brick back wall, a side window that flips between day and night, three bikes hung on wall hooks and one empty hook, a pegboard of tools, stacked tyres, a repair stand with a bike whose front wheel spins, a stool, a laptop table, a ring light on a tripod that sets up and packs away, a teal pendant lamp), box-built mechanic with an auburn bun, a teal bandana, freckles, a navy apron over a mustard tee whose colour changes clip by clip, a wrench, phone sheets for her post of a spinning wheel / YourBrand Getting started (three levels, Level 3 Time management & editing, the Batch step, seven days becoming three sessions) / her grid where the wheel has the longest view bar, hard cuts on voiceover word times
summary: A 40.8 second 9:16 reel in low-poly 3D: a bike mechanic posts every day from scratch: set up the light, film, edit, post, pack it away, Monday, Tuesday, Wednesday. By Sunday she is editing in her sleep and ends up asleep on a bike hook; she posted a wheel, just a wheel, spinning. Then YourBrand: Getting started, level three: batch it, film a week in one go, edit in a second, caption in a third; three short sessions beat seven long ones. The wheel got more views than her. She's fine.
aliases: film a week in one go
